description:
A new way to collaborate

Empowering teams by messenger, meetings, calendar, docs, and emails. It's all in one place.
Base
- Link a Base agent to your Base app to let users chat with it directly within the app, using natural language to look up information in the app, analyze the business, and get smart suggestions. From customer relationship management to project tracking and data analysis, it helps you quickly locate key information, follow up on progress, identify anomalies, and more.
